slowest_query.query: select "users".*, (select case when sum(case when status = 'active' and starts_at <= ? and (ends_at is null or ends_at > ?) then 1 else 0 end) > 0 then 'active' else 'ended' end from "entitlements" where "entitlements"."learner_id" = "users"."id" and "entitlements"."course_id" = ?) as "access_status", (select min(starts_at) from "entitlements" where "entitlements"."learner_id" = "users"."id" and "entitlements"."course_id" = ?) as "enrolled_at" from "users" where "users"."id" in (select "learner_id" from "entitlements" where "course_id" = ?) order by "users"."name" asc limit 15 offset 0
select count(*) as "aggregate" from "users" where "users"."id" in (select "learner_id" from "entitlements" where "course_id" = ?)

select "users".*, (select case when sum(case when status = 'active' and starts_at <= ? and (ends_at is null or ends_at > ?) then 1 else 0 end) > 0 then 'active' else 'ended' end from "entitlements" where "entitlements"."learner_id" = "users"."id" and "entitlements"."course_id" = ?) as "access_status", (select min(starts_at) from "entitlements" where "entitlements"."learner_id" = "users"."id" and "entitlements"."course_id" = ?) as "enrolled_at" from "users" where "users"."id" in (select "learner_id" from "entitlements" where "course_id" = ?) order by "users"."name" asc limit 15 offset 0
